words.ctx: if nobody comes forward, to a central lost-property office

ex.zh: 警方呼吁目击者站出来。

ex.en: Nobody [[came forward]] to claim the lost bag.
ex.zh: 没有人出面来认领那个丢失的包。

words.ctx: The scale is staggering.

ex.en: The cost of the project is [[staggering]].
ex.zh: 这个项目的成本高得惊人。

ex.en: She won the race by a [[staggering]] margin.
ex.zh: 她以惊人的优势赢得了比赛。

cloze.before: The scale is
cloze.szh: 规模之大，令人吃惊。

words.ctx: By sheer volume, umbrellas lead the pack

ex.en: The company drowned its rivals [[by sheer volume]], shipping ten times more products.
ex.zh: 这家公司单凭数量就压倒了对手，出货量是对方的十倍。

ex.en: [[By sheer volume]], English dominates academic publishing.
ex.zh: 单从数量上看，英语在学术出版中占据主导。

cloze.before: By sheer
cloze.after: , umbrellas lead the pack, yet almost nobody comes to claim them; a cheap umbrella is the one possession Tokyoites seem happy to lose.
cloze.szh: 单论数量，雨伞遥遥领先，但几乎没人来认领；便宜的雨伞，似乎是东京人唯一乐意丢掉的东西。

words.ctx: By sheer volume, umbrellas lead the pack

ex.en: Japan's bullet trains [[lead the pack]] on punctuality.
ex.zh: 在准点率方面，日本的新干线遥遥领先。

ex.en: Her start-up has begun to [[lead the pack]] in clean energy.
ex.zh: 她的初创公司已经开始在清洁能源领域领跑。

cloze.before: By sheer volume, umbrellas lead the

words.ctx: Wallets are another story.

ex.en: Cooking pasta is easy. Making it from scratch is [[another story]].
ex.zh: 煮意面很简单，从头自己做就是另一回事了。

ex.en: He plays the piano well, but singing is [[another story]].
ex.zh: 他钢琴弹得不错，唱歌就另当别论了。

cloze.before: Wallets are another
cloze.hint: X is another ____：X 则另当别论
cloze.szh: 钱包就另当别论了。

words.ctx: entitles them to a reward of between 5% and 20% of the item's value

ex.en: A valid ticket [[entitles]] you to a free drink.
ex.zh: 有效门票可以让你免费领取一杯饮料。

ex.en: Employees are [[entitled to]] four weeks of paid leave.
ex.zh: 员工有权享受四周带薪假期。

cloze.before: Japanese law obliges finders to hand in what they pick up, and
cloze.after: them to a reward of between 5% and 20% of the item's value, payable by the owner.

words.ctx: In practice, many finders reportedly waive it.

ex.en: The bank agreed to [[waive]] the late fee.
ex.zh: 银行同意免除滞纳金。

ex.en: Students may [[waive]] the fee if they show proof of low income.
ex.zh: 学生如果能出示低收入证明，可以免交这项费用。

cloze.before: In practice, many finders reportedly
cloze.after: it.
cloze.szh: 实际上，据说许多拾得者放弃了这笔报酬。

words.zh: 基础设施；这里引申为配套机制
words.ctx: The rest lies in infrastructure and habit.

ex.en: The country is investing heavily in transport [[infrastructure]].
ex.zh: 这个国家正在大力投资交通基础设施。

ex.en: Good ideas fail without the [[infrastructure]] to support them.
ex.zh: 没有配套机制的支撑，再好的点子也会落空。

cloze.before: The rest lies in
cloze.after: and habit.
cloze.hint: 基础设施；这里指配套机制
cloze.szh: 其余的原因在于配套机制和习惯。

words.zh: 乏味得恰到好处（反语式夸赞）
words.ctx: The process itself is gloriously dull, a form, a receipt, a database entry.

ex.en: The meeting was [[gloriously dull]]: nothing went wrong, and nothing happened.
ex.zh: 那场会议乏味得恰到好处：没出任何岔子，也什么都没发生。

ex.en: After a chaotic year, he longed for a [[gloriously dull]] weekend at home.
ex.zh: 经历了混乱的一年，他渴望在家过一个平平淡淡的周末。

cloze.before: The process itself is gloriously
cloze.after: , a form, a receipt, a database entry.
cloze.szh: 整个流程本身乏味得恰到好处：填一张表，拿一张收据，录入一条数据。

words.zh: 可以推广到别处的经验
words.ctx: It is a lesson that travels.

ex.en: Tokyo's lost-property system is [[a lesson that travels]]: any city could copy it.
ex.zh: 东京的失物招领体系是一个可以推广的经验：任何城市都能照搬。

ex.en: Her approach to teaching is [[a lesson that travels]] across subjects.
ex.zh: 她的教学方法是一条可以推广到各个学科的经验。

cloze.before: It is a lesson that
cloze.szh: 这是一条可以推广到别处的经验。

words.ctx: Counterintuitively, wallets containing more money were more likely to be returned, not less.

ex.en: [[Counterintuitively]], students who rested more scored higher.
ex.zh: 违反直觉的是，休息得更多的学生分数反而更高。

ex.en: [[Counterintuitively]], a smaller team often finishes the project faster.
ex.zh: 违反直觉的是，人少的团队往往完成项目更快。

cloze.after: , wallets containing more money were more likely to be returned, not less.

words.ctx: no amount of moral exhortation will fill the gap

ex.en: No [[exhortation]] from the coach could lift the team's spirits.
ex.zh: 教练再怎么规劝也提振不了队伍的士气。

ex.en: The speech was a long [[exhortation]] to work harder.
ex.zh: 这场演讲是一番冗长的规劝，要大家更加努力。

cloze.before: When the cost of doing the right thing falls to nearly zero, most people do it; when it does not, no amount of moral

cloze.szh: 当做正确的事的成本降到几乎为零，大多数人都会去做；当成本降不下来，再多的道德劝诫也填补不了这个缺口。

words.zh: 立法规定；这里指靠法律管控
words.ctx: the one thing Tokyo cannot legislate: the rain

ex.en: You cannot [[legislate]] good manners.
ex.zh: 礼貌是没法靠立法规定出来的。

ex.en: Parliament plans to [[legislate]] against fake reviews.
ex.zh: 议会打算立法禁止虚假评价。

cloze.after: : the rain.
cloze.szh: 与此同时，雨伞在饭田桥越堆越多，成了一座安静的纪念碑，纪念东京唯一无法立法规定的东西：雨。

ex.en: She [[cursed]] the rain when her umbrella blew inside out.
ex.zh: 伞被风吹翻的时候，她咒骂起这场雨。

ex.zh: 法律要求雇主提供安全的工作场所。

ex.en: Drivers are [[obliged]] to stop at a red light.
ex.zh: 司机必须在红灯前停车。

ex.zh: 一位站务员帮她找到了正确的站台。

ex.zh: 空乘人员给我们递上了茶。

ex.en: The fee is [[payable]] within 30 days.
ex.zh: 这笔费用须在 30 天内支付。

ex.en: Cheques should be made [[payable]] to the university.
ex.zh: 支票请开成以学校为收款人。

words.zh: adj. 壮观的；惊人的；（情况）更离谱的
words.note: in the more spectacular cases：在更夸张、更离谱的情况下
words.ctx: A commuter slumps onto a train, dozes off, and wakes up one stop too late, minus her umbrella, her scarf or, in the more spectacular cases, an envelope stuffed with cash.

ex.en: The fireworks over Tokyo Bay were [[spectacular]].
ex.zh: 东京湾上空的烟花美不胜收。

ex.en: The start-up's growth was [[spectacular]]; so was its collapse.
ex.zh: 这家初创公司的增长惊人，垮台也同样惊人。

ex.en: In the more [[spectacular]] cases, the fraud ran for a decade before anyone noticed.
ex.zh: 在更离谱的案例中，骗局持续了十年才被人发觉。

cloze.after: cases, an envelope stuffed with cash.
cloze.hint: 壮观的，惊人的；这里指“更离谱的”
cloze.szh: 一位通勤者瘫坐在电车上，打起瞌睡，醒来时已经坐过了一站，少了一把伞、一条围巾，更夸张的情况下，还少了一个塞满现金的信封。

words.note: 出自儿童顺口溜 “Finders keepers, losers weepers”（捡到的归自己，丢了的只能哭）。标题是反用：在东京，不是这样。
words.ctx: Finders, keepers? Not in Tokyo

ex.en: I found a ten-pound note on the bus, and my brother grinned: “[[Finders, keepers]]!”
ex.zh: 我在公交车上捡到一张十英镑的钞票，我弟弟咧嘴一笑：“谁捡到归谁！”

ex.en: Children chant “[[finders keepers]], losers weepers” in the playground, but the law is less forgiving.
ex.zh: 孩子们在操场上念着“捡到归己，丢了活该”，但法律就没这么宽容了。

ex.en: He took a “[[finders, keepers]]” attitude to the abandoned bike until its owner turned up.
ex.zh: 他对那辆被丢弃的自行车抱着“谁捡到归谁”的态度，直到车主出现。

cloze.before: Finders,
cloze.after: ? Not in Tokyo
cloze.szh: 捡到就归自己？在东京可不是这样。

words.zh: adj. 市民的；公民的；城市的
words.note: 常见搭配：civic duty 公民义务 / civic pride 城市自豪感 / civic life 公共生活
words.ctx: In one of the world's busiest cities, a forgotten umbrella sets off a small civic drama.

ex.en: Many people see voting as a [[civic]] duty.
ex.zh: 很多人把投票看作公民的义务。

ex.en: The town hall is the centre of [[civic]] life.
ex.zh: 市政厅是这座城市公共生活的中心。

ex.en: Residents showed real [[civic]] pride after the park was restored.
ex.zh: 公园修复之后，居民们表现出强烈的城市自豪感。

cloze.before: In one of the world's busiest cities, a forgotten umbrella sets off a small
cloze.after: drama.
cloze.hint: 市民的，公民的（civic drama：一场市民间的小风波）
cloze.szh: 在世界上最繁忙的城市之一，一把被遗忘的雨伞引发了一场小小的市民大戏。

words.zh: adv. 基本上；主要地；大体上
words.note: largely unnoticed：基本没人注意到。别和形容词 large 搞混。
words.ctx: Every weekday morning, a small miracle goes largely unnoticed in Tokyo.

ex.en: The report was [[largely]] ignored by the press.
ex.zh: 这份报告基本上被媒体忽视了。

ex.en: The delay was [[largely]] due to bad weather.
ex.zh: 这次延误主要是因为天气不好。

ex.en: The city is [[largely]] safe, though a few areas need caution.
ex.zh: 这座城市基本上是安全的，不过有几个区域需要小心。

cloze.before: Every weekday morning, a small miracle goes
cloze.after: unnoticed in Tokyo.
cloze.szh: 每个工作日的早晨，东京都有一个小小的奇迹发生，却几乎没人留意。

words.note: 句型：one + 时间/距离单位 + too late，表示“晚了那么一点”。

ex.en: I fell asleep on the Yamanote Line and woke up [[one stop too late]].
ex.zh: 我在山手线上睡着了，醒来时已经坐过了一站。

ex.en: She noticed the announcement [[one stop too late]] and had to double back.
ex.zh: 她听到广播时已经过了一站，只好折返。

ex.en: We got off [[one stop too late]] and had to take a taxi back.
ex.zh: 我们下车晚了一站，只好打车回去。

words.note: 口语里常带幽默或无奈，暗示“本该有却没了”。数学里的 minus 才是“减”。
words.ctx: A commuter slumps onto a train, dozes off, and wakes up one stop too late, minus her umbrella, her scarf or, in the more spectacular cases, an envelope stuffed with cash.

ex.en: He came back from holiday [[minus]] his luggage.
ex.zh: 他度假回来了，行李却丢了。

ex.en: She walked in, [[minus]] her usual smile.
ex.zh: 她走了进来，脸上少了往常的笑容。

ex.en: We arrived at the party [[minus]] the cake, which was still in the car.
ex.zh: 我们到了聚会现场，蛋糕却没带来——它还留在车里。

ex.zh: 我赶到车站时，末班车已经开走了。

ex.en: [[By the time]] you read this, I will have landed in Shanghai.
ex.zh: 等你读到这条消息的时候，我应该已经降落在上海了。

ex.en: [[By the time]] the police arrived, the thief had disappeared.
ex.zh: 警察赶到的时候，小偷已经不见了。

ex.zh: 她最珍视的物品是祖父留下的一台旧相机。

ex.zh: 请乘客随时随身携带好个人物品。

ex.en: The police found him in [[possession]] of a stolen wallet.
ex.zh: 警方发现他持有一个被盗的钱包。

cloze.before: By sheer volume, umbrellas lead the pack, yet almost nobody comes to claim them; a cheap umbrella is the one
cloze.after: Tokyoites seem happy to lose.
cloze.szh: 单论数量，雨伞遥遥领先，但几乎没人来认领；便宜的雨伞，似乎是东京人唯一乐意丢掉的东西。

words.note: 名词 + and all，放在句末，表示“连带着也一起”。
words.ctx: A striking share of them find their way back to their owners, cash and all.

ex.en: She swallowed the sandwich, crust [[and all]].
ex.zh: 她把三明治整个吞了下去，连面包边也不剩。

ex.en: He fell into the river, phone [[and all]].
ex.zh: 他掉进了河里，连手机也一起掉了进去。

ex.en: They bought the old house, furniture [[and all]].
ex.zh: 他们买下了那栋老房子，家具也一并带走。

cloze.before: A striking share of them find their way back to their owners, cash and
cloze.szh: 其中相当大一部分都找到了回到失主手里的路，连里面的现金也一分不少。

words.zh: 上交；提交（作业、失物、辞呈等）
words.note: 可以拆开用：hand it in。hand in 偏“交上去”，hand over 偏“移交”。
words.ctx: Japanese law obliges finders to hand in what they pick up, and entitles them to a reward of between 5% and 20% of the item's value, payable by the owner.

ex.en: Please [[hand in]] your essays by Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五之前交上论文。

ex.en: She [[handed in]] the lost wallet at the nearest police box.
ex.zh: 她把捡到的钱包交给了最近的警亭。

ex.en: He [[handed in]] his notice last week.
ex.zh: 他上周递交了辞呈。

cloze.before: Japanese law obliges finders to
cloze.after: in what they pick up, and entitles them to a reward of between 5% and 20% of the item's value, payable by the owner.
cloze.szh: 日本法律要求拾得者上交捡到的东西，同时赋予他们获得物品价值 5% 到 20% 报酬的权利，由失主支付。

words.zh: 事实上；实际上（对比：in theory 理论上）
words.note: 常和 in theory 成对出现：理论上如何，实际上却不一定。
words.ctx: In practice, many finders reportedly waive it.

ex.en: In theory the system is simple; [[in practice]], it takes hours.
ex.zh: 理论上这个系统很简单，实际操作起来却要花好几个小时。

ex.en: The rule applies to everyone, but [[in practice]] it is rarely enforced.
ex.zh: 这条规定对所有人适用，但实际上很少被执行。

ex.en: [[In practice]], most people just click “accept” without reading.
ex.zh: 实际上，大多数人根本不看就点了“同意”。

cloze.before: In
cloze.after: , many finders reportedly waive it.
cloze.hint: In ____：事实上，实际上（对比 in theory）
cloze.szh: 实际上，据说许多拾得者放弃了这笔报酬。

words.note: 消息来自报道或传闻，作者并没有亲自核实，新闻里很常见。
words.ctx: In practice, many finders reportedly waive it.

ex.en: The singer has [[reportedly]] cancelled her tour.
ex.zh: 据报道，这位歌手已经取消了巡演。

ex.en: The company [[reportedly]] lost millions last year.
ex.zh: 据说这家公司去年亏损了数百万。

ex.en: He was [[reportedly]] furious when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 据说他听到消息时非常愤怒。

cloze.before: In practice, many finders
cloze.after: waive it.
cloze.szh: 实际上，据说许多拾得者放弃了这笔报酬。

words.note: lie（位于；在于）的变形是 lie – lay – lain，三单 lies；撒谎的 lie 过去式才是 lied。
words.ctx: The rest lies in infrastructure and habit.

ex.en: The secret of her success [[lies in]] hard work, not talent.
ex.zh: 她成功的秘诀在于努力，而不是天赋。

ex.en: The problem [[lies in]] how the data is collected.
ex.zh: 问题出在数据的收集方式上。

ex.en: The charm of the old town [[lies in]] its narrow streets.
ex.zh: 这座老城的魅力就在于那些狭窄的街道。

cloze.before: The rest
cloze.after: in infrastructure and habit.
cloze.hint: 在于……（原因、关键所在；注意动词形式）
cloze.szh: 其余的原因在于配套机制和习惯。

words.note: 比 not only 更书面；常见结构 not merely A but (also) B。
words.ctx: Honesty, in other words, is not merely a personal virtue.

ex.en: The museum is [[not merely]] a building but a living archive.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆不仅仅是一栋建筑，更是一座活的档案馆。

ex.en: It is [[not merely]] a matter of money.
ex.zh: 这不仅仅是钱的问题。

ex.en: She is [[not merely]] talented; she is also relentlessly disciplined.
ex.zh: 她不仅仅有天赋，还自律得近乎苛刻。

cloze.before: Honesty, in other words, is not
cloze.after: a personal virtue.
cloze.szh: 换句话说，诚实不只是一种个人美德。

words.note: by virtue of ……：凭借、由于（较正式）。
words.ctx: Honesty, in other words, is not merely a personal virtue.

ex.en: Patience is a [[virtue]].
ex.zh: 耐心是一种美德。

ex.en: The plan's main [[virtue]] is its simplicity.
ex.zh: 这个方案最大的优点就是简单。

ex.en: She got the job [[by virtue of]] her experience, not her connections.
ex.zh: 她得到这份工作是凭借经验，而不是人脉。

cloze.before: Honesty, in other words, is not merely a personal
cloze.szh: 换句话说，诚实不只是一种个人美德。

words.note: amount 后面接不可数名词；后半句常用 will / can。
words.ctx: When the cost of doing the right thing falls to nearly zero, most people do it; when it does not, no amount of moral exhortation will fill the gap.

ex.en: [[No amount of]] apologies will undo the damage.
ex.zh: 再多的道歉也无法挽回这些损失。

ex.en: [[No amount of]] coffee will make me enjoy Monday mornings.
ex.zh: 再多的咖啡也不会让我爱上周一的早晨。

ex.en: [[No amount of]] training will make up for a lack of curiosity.
ex.zh: 再多的训练也弥补不了好奇心的缺失。

cloze.before: When the cost of doing the right thing falls to nearly zero, most people do it; when it does not, no
cloze.after: of moral exhortation will fill the gap.
cloze.szh: 当做正确的事的成本降到几乎为零，大多数人都会去做；当成本降不下来，再多的道德劝诫也填补不了这个缺口。

words.note: scratch 原指赛跑时在地上划出的起跑线，from scratch 就是“从起跑线出发”，不借助现成的东西。做菜时指不用半成品、用原材料自己做。常和 start / build / make / cook 连用。
words.ctx: Cooking pasta is easy. Making it from scratch is another story.

ex.en: She lost all her files and had to write the report [[from scratch]].
ex.zh: 她的文件全丢了，只好从头重写报告。

ex.en: This cake is made [[from scratch]], not from a box mix.
ex.zh: 这个蛋糕是用原材料自己做的，不是用预拌粉。

ex.en: They built the company [[from scratch]] with just two laptops.
ex.zh: 他们只靠两台笔记本电脑，白手起家建起了这家公司。

cloze.before: Cooking pasta is easy. Making it
cloze.after: is another story.
cloze.hint: 从零开始；用原材料自己做
cloze.szh: 煮意面很简单，从头自己做就是另一回事了。
